meaning: Total collectible pellets in the maze: 240 regular dots + 4 energizers. Loaded as the literal #f4 in the fruit-bonus-threshold routine, which subtracts the running dot-eaten count from this same 244 to find how many dots remain (the dossier's 'first fruit at 70 dots eaten, second at 170' logic). src/core/maze.ts derives DOT_COUNT = TOTAL_PELLETS - ENERGIZER_TILES.length = 240 from this constant, cross-checked at module load against the row table's own dot count.
